hotels.title: Sanctuary Cove Icon: Gold Coast Haven with Lagoon Pool, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: Fall in love with the Gold Coast’s laidback atmosphere at this five-star Sanctuary Cove reprieve. This idyllic hideaway is superbly set across more than nine acres of tropical gardens, boasting a sprawling one-acre lagoon pool so you can soak up the tropics from every luxurious angle. Dining at this resort is defined by multiple unique culinary experiences. Savour the flavours of wood-fired fare in rustic-chic surrounds at The Fireplace, then dive into a whiskey tasting at the lively Verandah Restaurant & Bar. Treat yourself to high tea or elevate your poolside relaxation with refreshing cocktails and poke bowls influenced by local flavours. Practise your swing on the neighbouring, critically acclaimed golf courses, or take a stroll to the Marine Village for world-class dining, nightlife, cafes and boutique shopping. Let the little ones run wild in the fun-filled indoor playroom at Planet Trekkers Kids' Club, or venture further afar to the world-renowned Gold Coast theme parks, just a 10-minute drive from the resort.

hotels.title: Gold Coast Five-Star Sanctuary Cove Retreat with One-Acre Lagoon Beach Pool
hotels.description: Fall in love with the Gold Coast's laidback atmosphere at InterContinental Sanctuary Cove Resort, an IHG Hotel. This idyllic hideaway is superbly set on 4.2-hectares of tropical gardens and boasts a sprawling one-acre lagoon pool and four exquisite dining destinations. The world-renowned Gold Coast theme parks are just a 10-minute drive away, and guests can also enjoy easy access to the tranquil Marine Village or critically-acclaimed golf course.
